note: Third-party code is kept outside git. These are the exact commits downloaded and pinned under third_party; each repo's SOURCE.json has per-file sha256. The adapter imports this code read-only and applies only documented loading shims.

spai: saved config lacks MODEL_WEIGHTS; set to 'mfm' (code default)
saved config lacks MODEL.FRE.DISABLE_RECONSTRUCTION_SIMILARITY; set to False (code default)
torch.load(weights_only=True) rejects yacs CfgNode; use weights_only=False on the trusted official upload
official spai.utils imports seaborn/pandas; both installed in the isolated venv
official backbones imports OpenAI clip; a stub module is enough because the selected model is ViT/MFM, not CLIP
aide: official AIDE_Model asks open_clip for pretrained ConvNeXt-XXL; the checkpoint already contains the trunk, so pass pretrained=None and load the full state dict
official models/AIDE.py imports OpenAI clip; unused in the forward path, stub module is enough
DCT preprocessing is pure torch; kornia is only needed by the training dataset and is not used by the offline adapter
